quotes.text: translateTo would return an URL-encoded vCard. toVCard doesn't.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Use toVCard()/abCardToVCard() for raw vCard text. Apply encodeURIComponent only when constructing a data:text/vcard URI; Blob/export consumers receive raw text. Replace ambiguous multi-format translateTo dispatch with explicit conversion methods when touching this API. toVCard ensures a UID if absent. Address-book lists are not supported as vCard in this path. Current accepted source retains the raw contract.
title: Keep vCard text raw and encode it only at a URI boundary
